coordinate_convention.verification: Every primary and qualification span is recovered exactly by slicing the input text and the mapped full-source text; both input text hashes and all source maps were verified.

scope_policy.counting: 50 is the count of annotated propositions, not 50 independent obligations. Definitions, parent list acceptance, options, explanations and separately linked exceptions are intentionally distinguishable through counting_role. Qualifier units must not be double-counted as additional duties.
scope_policy.selected_only: Only input.json text and contiguous-input.json text establish candidate coverage. Context-only facts and requirements are not counted as omitted.
scope_policy.metadata: Input section labels and source mappings identify each excerpt. Document titles, CT dates and inserted separators are provenance/structure rather than substantive duties.
scope_policy.discontinuous_input: The selected input concatenates excerpts in a different order from the full source. Repeated c/d labels do not create one continuous section. Court clauses belong to 8 FAM 403.1-4(A); the final c-e clauses belong to Name Suffixes, 8 FAM 403.1-5(B).
scope_policy.contiguous_input: The contiguous input consists only of 8 FAM 403.1-4(a)-(d). It does not contain applicant/minor definitions, court-finality clauses, name-spacing clauses or suffix clauses. Those cannot be omissions from that run.
scope_policy.unresolved_references: Preserve each cited identifier and stated relationship. Referenced contents were not incorporated even where contextual source happened to display the target section.
scope_policy.no_external_fact_claim: This inventory describes the supplied source snapshot; no live legal authority or current web page was verified.

Older-than-one-year DS-11 plus unchanged ID leads to suspension/new-name-ID request, with the urgent-time-shortage limited-validity permission. Within-one-year DS-11 excuses new-name ID but requires name-change documentation when ID is unchanged. Exact year-boundary semantics remain unspecified.
Practical need for documentation explains its return. Fully notate, including seen and returned, before returning to the applicant with the IRL.
Finality constraint and distinct passport/FS-240 new-name prohibitions coexist with a clearance duty despite nonfinality or present nonissuance.

Both names ordinarily belong on the court document. A confidential former name triggers a branch requiring both names on the application and permitting additional evidence under the cited regulations.
Prior passport and no-prior-passport evidence branches use should; clear preference communicated verbally or in writing supports may add or remove. Do not flatten to mandatory unconditional actions.
General-family consistency has an explicit preference exception; the separate special-issuance sponsor note does not specify its interaction with that exception.
Spacing and suffix rewrite rules are distinct, qualified by generally and Department disregard of clear preference. Neither exception alone mandates a rewrite.
Possible Señor sense is descriptive; determining that sense triggers an imperative to follow referenced ranks-and-titles guidance.
